column1: # What a second tone key does: it replaces, removes or is typed literally, never stacks.
# cyc-a-s-f: f replaces s: a second tone key sets its own tone, it does not stack
# cyc-a-s-s: typing the same tone key twice removes the mark and keeps the literal key
# cyc-a-ww: same removal cycle on the vowel mark: the second w is kept literally
# cyc-a-r: r replaces s, like f above
